method.primary: Visible scene-graph inventory after real material batching and instancing. Triangles include instance counts; bytes count unique geometry attributes and indices, excluding textures/driver storage. This is deterministic submitted-geometry potential, not frustum-culling-aware renderer timings or GPU-memory telemetry.
method.modelState: Production createSpacecraft(THREE); setLayout(wide/compact), update(0, home, true, {activeRoom: home, layout, delta: 0, immediateDoors: true}); updateMatrixWorld(true). Real production material batches and static instances.
method.meshCount: Visible mesh nodes below the traversed root, after batching; draw-call candidates, not observed renderer draw calls. Instanced meshes count as one node.
method.triangleCount: Index count or position count / 3, multiplied by each InstancedMesh count. Does not account for frustum culling or additional rendering passes.
method.geometryArrayBytes: Sum of indices and geometry attributes once per unique geometry within each inventory. Excludes instanceMatrix/instanceColor arrays, texture allocations, transient arrays, driver resources and actual process/GPU memory.
method.namedGroupVisibility: Named subgroup inventories traverseVisible from that subgroup; hidden ancestors are not included in Three.js traversal checks. groupEffectiveVisibility records full ancestor visibility. Both exterior variants are deliberately inventoried as authored subgroups; whole-scene inventory includes only the currently visible variant.
method.retainedSceneGraph: Separate traverse (not traverseVisible) of the full production scene graph includes hidden layout variants. It excludes detached source solids, geometry caches and objects no longer retained by this graph; it is not a complete application-memory measurement.
method.fingerprint: SHA-256 in visible subtree traversal order over mesh world matrix, semantic parts, instance count, material color/emissive/emissiveIntensity/roughness/metalness/opacity/transparency/side; sorted geometry attribute/index names, item sizes, normalization, typed array types and raw bytes; instanceMatrix bytes where present. Texture pixels, shader output and transient object IDs are excluded.
method.linerSelection: Visible production meshes whose name or userData.parts contains walkway-continuous-rear-liner. Result is the single walkway-plain-cabin-enamel mesh with only that source part; no proxy geometry.
method.ladderWithoutServiceSpine: Visible meshes under left-vertical-walkway excluding meshes whose name or semantic parts begins service-spine-. Uses actual production geometry/materials/transforms. The separate wall isolation cassette is outside this named ladder group and compared separately.
method.sourceIsolation: Fresh source-only git archive of features, lib, scripts, package.json and package-lock.json at cf7bda42d95e9fbcda2f87d353af506f4bed91d2; only node_modules shared by symlink. No private environment, store, uploads or secrets copied. Disposable baseline removed after successful measurement.
method.supplemental: Immediately deep-clone every wide and compact snapshot before switching layouts. Compare each protected inventory, geometry/material/transform fingerprint, bounds and metadata snapshot exactly. Equal records are stored once as shared values; canonical JSON hashes preserve compact evidence for equal framing and route fields.
method.canonicalMetadataHash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with lexically sorted object keys and compact separators. Equality is checked on full deep-cloned values before hashing, not inferred from selected counts.

fixture.browser: None; this deterministic Node inventory has no WebGL, real canvas artwork, viewport or browser renderer. Visual evidence is separate.

interpretation: The continuous tread backing and thicker alloy grasps add 972 triangles and 25,032 geometry-array bytes per layout. The service spine remains 17 mesh candidates and the whole scene remains 520; these are scene-graph counts rather than measured renderer draws.

Service spine: 69,208 to 70,180 triangles and 2,821,736 to 2,846,768 geometry-array bytes. Whole ladder subgroup: 118,980 to 119,952 triangles. Whole scene: wide 994,520 to 995,492 triangles; compact 972,840 to 973,812 triangles.

All measured bounds, service metadata, shared camera framing, required framing points, apertures, route/adjacency snapshots, iris poses and passage linings remain exactly unchanged. Continuous liner, end fittings, spanners, all four cabins and their fittings, the isolation cassette, docking/service assembly and exterior groups retain identical measured fingerprints and inventories.
This is a user-requested contrast correction and a new authored design baseline. Counts do not establish a rendering-time, memory, heat or battery effect.
limitations: Triangle and mesh inventories do not apply frustum culling or account for shadow, AO and postprocessing passes; no CPU/GPU timing or frame-pacing result was measured.
Geometry arrays exclude instance attributes, textures, transient arrays, caches and driver allocations. Retained scene-graph inventory is not complete process or GPU memory.
Nested service, ladder and whole-scene deltas overlap and must not be added. Geometry is deduplicated only within each inventory.
Per-group traversal ignores hidden ancestors; effectiveSceneVisibility explicitly identifies inactive exterior variants. Whole-scene inventory honors the complete visibility tree.
Exact source and metadata comparisons do not replace rendered visual review or live navigation checks.
